title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_spectrogram() sets spectrogram computed (window length wl, overlap ovlp, window function wn) drawn (color palette pal, amplitude levels colors collevels, background colbg). arguments passed seewave::spectro(): Black white spectrogram wider amplitude range (fainter sounds shown): default spectrogram background color lowest amplitude palette (dark purple ‘viridis’), quiet parts sound background look . colbg sets another spectrogram background: backgrounds figure set independently: colbg ds_spectrogram() (ds_theme()) spectrogram, col.panel ds_theme() oscillograms, envelopes power spectra, bg ds_theme() whole figure around panels: paged spectrograms palette can also name ‘viridis’ palette (e.g. “magma”) two colors gradient, amp.trans brightens spectrogram (nonlinear transformation collapses difference loud quiet sounds; 1 means transformation):
code: ds_scythebill <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +   ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))  # a longer recording for scrolling spectrograms ds_antshrike <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +   ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))  # palette and amplitude range ds_scythebill + ds_spectrogram(pal = mako, collevels = seq(-100, 0, 1)) ds_scythebill + ds_spectrogram(pal = reverse.gray.colors.1, collevels = seq(-100, 0, 5)) ds_scythebill + ds_spectrogram(pal = viridis, colbg = "black") +   ds_theme(col.axis = "white", col.lab = "white") ds_scythebill +   ds_spectrogram(pal = viridis) +   ds_oscillogram(col = "white") +   ds_theme(col.panel = "gray20", bg = "gray90") ds_scythebill +   ds_spectrogram(amp.trans = 3, collevels = seq(-35, 0, 1)) +   ds_paged(t.display = 1) +   ds_theme(axis.type = "standard")

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: Oscillograms amplitude envelopes can go spectrogram (position), color (col) height relative spectrogram (height). Power spectra go left right side (side), given width (width, proportion figure): amplitude envelope instead oscillogram (oscillograms envelopes show information, better combined): several rows row shows power spectrum, scale: scrolling spectrograms lower panel can overview whole sound (ds_overview(), relative height), oscillogram envelope:
code: cols <- mako(10)  ds_scythebill +   ds_spectrogram(pal = mako, collevels = seq(-100, 0, 1)) +   ds_oscillogram(position = "above", col = cols[3], height = 0.3) +   ds_spectrum(side = "left", col = cols[5], width = 0.12) ds_scythebill +   ds_spectrogram(pal = mako, collevels = seq(-100, 0, 1)) +   ds_envelope(col = cols[5], height = 0.3) data("antshrike")  ds_antshrike <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 4)) +    ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))  ds_antshrike + ds_spectrum(col = cols[5]) +   ds_static(rows = 2, height = 350) ds_antshrike +   ds_envelope(col = cols[5]) +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 2)

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_theme() sets look styles: axis titles (xlab, ylab), size titles labels (cex.lab, cex.axis), font titles (font.lab), color axes text (col.lab) axis labels alone (col.axis), type axes (axis.type) background around panels (bg): also sets font family text (family), orientation axis labels axes (las, base R: 0 parallel axis, 1 horizontal, 2 perpendicular, 3 vertical), length ticks (tick.length), boxes around panels (box, col.box), grid lines (grid, col.grid), background oscillogram, envelope spectrum panels (col.panel) color size titles (col.title, cex.title): Themes can also set colors plot: spectrogram palette background (pal, colbg), color oscillograms, envelopes spectra (col.wave), color annotations (col.annotation), play line (col.line) highlight box paged spectrograms (col.highlight). used supplied layers (e.g. ds_spectrogram(pal = ) takes precedence). col.bar bg.bar set colors player controls web pages. dark theme:
code: ds_scythebill +   ds_oscillogram() +   ds_theme(     xlab = "Time (s)",     ylab = "Frequency (kHz)",     cex.lab = 1.4,     font.lab = 2,     col.lab = "gray30"   ) ds_scythebill +   ds_oscillogram() +   ds_spectrum() +   ds_theme(     family = "serif",     las = 1,     tick.length = 0.3,     box = FALSE,     grid = TRUE,     col.panel = "gray95"   ) ds_scythebill +   ds_oscillogram() +   ds_theme(     bg = "black",     col.lab = "white",     pal = viridis,     colbg = "black",     col.wave = viridis(10)[7],     col.line = "white",     col.bar = "white",     bg.bar = "black"   )

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: Preset themes set several settings : ds_theme_dark(), ds_theme_mako() (light theme ‘mako’ palette spectrogram, panels, annotations player controls), ds_theme_presentation() (large bold text slides), ds_theme_paper() (black white serif fonts, printed figures), ds_theme_minimal() (boxes light gray axes), ds_theme_transparent() (transparent background, blend slides web pages color), ds_theme_void() (axes boxes), ds_theme_xenocanto() (inspired player Xeno-canto) ds_theme_macaulay() (inspired player Macaulay Library). settings can changed call, adding ds_theme() afterwards (adding preset replaces previous themes): ds_theme_xenocanto() uses gray spectrogram, labels inside figure, solid play line rounded player controls seek bar. looks best scrolling spectrograms whose time axis moves along (fix.time = FALSE) short oscillogram: presets, settings can changed. instance, color version Xeno-canto player: ds_theme_macaulay() uses gray spectrogram, compact axes (frequency labels narrow column left time minutes seconds figure) black player bar square play button. looks best scrolling spectrograms overview whole sound (part shown highlighted): look themes comes settings can used theme. Xeno-canto theme uses axis.type = "inside" (labels units inside figure), lty.line lwd.line (type width play line scrolling spectrograms) bar.style = "rounded" (round player controls seek bar, bg.bar background). Macaulay theme uses axis.type = "compact", bar.style = "square" (flat bar square play button color play line) col.highlight (color dimming overview outside part shown). axis.type can “standard”, “inside”, “compact”, “none” , scrolling spectrograms, “minimal” (1 s 1 kHz scale bars):
code: ds_scythebill +   ds_envelope() +   ds_theme_dark(cex.lab = 1.3) +   ds_player(buttons = c("time", "loop", "volume")) ds_scythebill +   ds_oscillogram() +   ds_theme_paper() ds_antshrike +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 2) +   ds_theme_presentation() ds_antshrike +   ds_oscillogram(height = 0.2) +   ds_theme_xenocanto() +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE) ds_antshrike +   ds_oscillogram(height = 0.2) +   ds_theme_xenocanto(     pal = viridis::inferno,     colbg = "black",     bg = "black",     col.panel = "black",     col.wave = "white",     col.lab = "white",     col.line = "white"   ) +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE) ds_antshrike +   ds_overview() +   ds_theme_macaulay() +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE) ds_antshrike +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 2) +   ds_theme(axis.type = "minimal")

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_set_theme() sets theme spectrograms shown afterwards R session (e.g. code chunks document), ggplot2::theme_set(). ds_theme() added spectrogram changes settings, preset themes replace . ds_set_theme() returns previous theme, can restored (ds_set_theme(NULL) removes ):
code: old <- ds_set_theme(ds_theme_paper(cex.lab = 1.3))  # paper theme ds_scythebill + ds_oscillogram() # paper theme with another axis title ds_scythebill + ds_envelope() + ds_theme(ylab = "Freq. (kHz)") # restore the previous theme ds_set_theme(old)

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: Static spectrograms default style, ds_static() needed change settings switch back another style (last style added used). ds_static() sets color play line active buttons (lcol), size resolution row (width, height, pixels, res), number rows (rows), whether play line shown (play.line) frames per second videos (fps): Without moving line (clicking figure still plays sound point):
code: ds_scythebill +   ds_static(lcol = "#E69F00", width = 1200, height = 400, res = 120) ds_scythebill + ds_static(play.line = FALSE)

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_scrolling() sets time window shown (t.display), whether time axis moves along spectrogram (fix.time = FALSE), play line (lcol, lty, lwd), initial speed (speed), delay spectrogram starts moving (buffer, s), looping (loop), size resolution frames (width, height, res) frames per second videos (fps): Long-billed hermit song 1/5 speed, without axes looping (web pages loop paused): first 20 s northern nightingale wren recording xeno-canto using custom color palette: Spix’s disc-winged bat inquiry call slowed 16 times (speed = 0.0625, slowest speed web browsers can play): options ds_scrolling() custom spectrogram function (spectro.call, call made base::call()), spectral derivatives (derivative = TRUE, requires package ‘imager’) window length ms (hop.size).
code: ds_antshrike +   ds_spectrogram(pal = viridis, colbg = "black") +   ds_oscillogram(col = "#31688E99") +   ds_scrolling(     t.display = 2,     fix.time = FALSE,     speed = 0.5,     lcol = "white",     lty = 1,     width = 1000,     height = 500,     res = 120   ) data("Phae.long4", package = "NatureSounds")  dynaspec(Phae.long4, flim = c(1, 10)) +   ds_spectrogram(     wl = 300,     ovlp = 90,     pal = magma,     collevels = seq(-50, 0, 5),     colbg = "black"   ) +   ds_scrolling(     t.display = 1.7,     width = 1000,     height = 500,     res = 120,     speed = 0.2,     loop = 3   ) +   ds_theme(axis.type = "none") nightingale_wren <- tempfile(fileext = ".mp3") download.file(   "https://xeno-canto.org/518334/download",   nightingale_wren,   mode = "wb" )  custom_pal <- colorRampPalette(c(   "#2d2d86",   "#2d2d86",   reverse.terrain.colors(10)[5:10] ))  dynaspec(nightingale_wren, flim = c(0, 8), tlim = 20) +   ds_spectrogram(     wl = 600,     ovlp = 95,     pal = custom_pal,     collevels = seq(-40, 0, 5),     colbg = "#2d2d86"   ) +   ds_scrolling(     t.display = 3,     width = 700,     height = 250,     res = 100,     lcol = "#FFFFFFE6"   ) data("thyroptera.est", package = "NatureSounds")  # extract one call thy_wav <- attributes(thyroptera.est)$wave.objects[[12]]  # convert to 16 bits (as the silence added below) thy_wav <- tuneR::normalize(thy_wav, unit = "16")  # add silence at both sides thy_wav <- pastew(   tuneR::silence(     duration = 0.05,     samp.rate = thy_wav@samp.rate,     xunit = "time"   ),   thy_wav,   output = "Wave" ) thy_wav <- pastew(   thy_wav,   tuneR::silence(     duration = 0.04,     samp.rate = thy_wav@samp.rate,     xunit = "time"   ),   output = "Wave" )  dynaspec(thy_wav, flim = c(12, 45)) +   ds_spectrogram(     wl = 400,     ovlp = 95,     pal = inferno,     collevels = seq(-40, 0, 5),     colbg = "black"   ) +   ds_oscillogram(col = inferno(10, alpha = 0.9)[3]) +   ds_scrolling(     t.display = 0.08,     width = 700,     height = 250,     res = 100,     lcol = "#FFFFFFE6",     lty = 1,     speed = 0.0625,     loop = 4   )

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_paged() sets duration page (t.display), highlight box (highlight.col, highlight.alpha), cursor (lcol), title (title), amplitude color scale (plot.legend = TRUE), size pages (spec.width, spec.height, inches) frames per second videos (fps). arguments set preparation pages (e.g. resample.rate, amp.thresh filter): first 12 s humpback whale song, 3 s pages frequency range used whales (0-700 Hz): common nighthawk call xeno-canto two-color palette:
code: ds_scythebill +   ds_spectrogram(amp.trans = 3, collevels = seq(-35, 0, 1)) +   ds_paged(     t.display = 1,     title = "Brown-billed scythebill",     highlight.col = "#2d2d86",     highlight.alpha = 0.4,     lcol = "#FFEA46"   ) +   ds_theme(bg = "black") whale <- tempfile(fileext = ".wav") download.file(   "http://www.oceanmammalinst.org/songs/hmpback3.wav",   whale,   mode = "wb" )  dynaspec(whale, flim = c(0, 0.7), tlim = 12) +   ds_spectrogram(amp.trans = 3) +   ds_paged(t.display = 3) nighthawk <- tempfile(fileext = ".mp3") download.file("https://xeno-canto.org/490771/download", nighthawk, mode = "wb")  dynaspec(nighthawk, tlim = 20) +   ds_spectrogram(pal = c("white", "black")) +   ds_paged(t.display = 4, highlight.col = "#d1b0ff", lcol = "#7817ff")

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_annotations() highlights parts sound translucent boxes. takes data frame start end selection (s), selection tables warbleR ohun. ‘bottom.freq’ ‘top.freq’ columns (kHz) boxes span frequency range, colors labels can taken columns: box borders set border (color name column color box), lwd (width) lty (line type): ds_annotations() also sets opacity boxes (alpha), size labels (cex) whether boxes span frequency range selections (freq). following code highlights male female parts house wren duet (downloading recording selection table GitHub): box borders, spanning whole frequency range (freq = FALSE), oscillogram: type = "spectrogram" colors spectrogram within selection, gradient spectrogram background color selection (warbleR::color_spectro()), instead drawing boxes. narrower amplitude range (collevels) keeps background noise uncolored: type = "line" draws horizontal line start end selection, frequency set line.freq (kHz, name column frequency line), common figures duets. Lines thick opaque default (lwd = 8, alpha = 1), labels shown : Selection tables made warbleR can used directly. selections several sound files, sound shown used (matching file name), sound file chosen sound.file (e.g. ‘Wave’ objects):
code: # note types st <- data.frame(   start = c(0.34, 1.13, 1.44, 1.75),   end = c(1.03, 1.36, 1.68, 2.28),   bottom.freq = c(2.5, 2.4, 2.3, 2.1),   top.freq = c(3.9, 4, 3.8, 5.4),   labels = c("A", "B", "B", "C"),   colors = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#56B4E9", "#009E73") )  ds_scythebill + ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", labels = "labels") ds_scythebill +   ds_annotations(     st,     col = "colors",     alpha = 0.1,     border = "colors",     lwd = 2,     lty = "dashed",     labels = "labels"   ) # house wren male-female duet recording hs_wren <- tempfile(fileext = ".wav") download.file(   "https://github.com/maRce10/example_sounds/raw/refs/heads/main/house_wren_male_female_duet.wav",   hs_wren,   mode = "wb" )  # and selection table st <- read.csv(   "https://github.com/maRce10/example_sounds/raw/refs/heads/main/house_wren_male_female_duet.csv" )  # colors and labels st$colors <- viridis(10)[c(3, 8)] st$labels <- c("male", "female")  duet <- dynaspec(hs_wren, flim = c(1, 13)) +   ds_spectrogram(     wl = 512,     pal = reverse.gray.colors.1,     collevels = seq(-100, 0, 1)   ) +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 1.2, loop = 3, width = 1000, height = 500, res = 120)  duet + ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", alpha = 0.4, labels = "labels", cex = 1.5) duet +   ds_annotations(     st,     col = "colors",     alpha = 0.3,     border = "gray30",     lwd = 2,     freq = FALSE   ) +   ds_oscillogram() duet +   ds_spectrogram(collevels = seq(-60, 0, 1)) +   ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", type = "spectrogram", labels = "labels") # one line height for each individual st$line.freq <- c(12, 11.2)  duet +   ds_annotations(     st,     col = "colors",     type = "line",     line.freq = "line.freq",     labels = "labels"   ) data("lbh_selec_table", package = "warbleR") data("Phae.long1", package = "NatureSounds")  dynaspec(Phae.long1, flim = c(1, 10)) +   ds_spectrogram(wl = 300) +   ds_annotations(lbh_selec_table, sound.file = "Phae.long1.wav", labels = "selec")

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_captions() adds text fixed position figure (x y, proportions figure width height), shown time range sound (start end, s). fading adds fade-fade-effects (s), col, cex font set color, size font. Several captions can shown one , several caption layers can added different positions. following code labels frog species calling recording Costa Rica: Note times annotations captions refer original recording, even part used (tlim).

title: Customizing dynamic spectrograms
text: ds_player() sets speeds offered speed slider web pages (first one initial speed; single speed hides slider), whether pitch kept slowing default additional controls shown (buttons). player play button, instance embed presentation: player controls, starting half speed looping (loop button starts pressed ds_scrolling(loop) larger 1): scrolling spectrograms, buttons = "zoom" adds slider (- + buttons) stretch shrink spectrogram, 4 times less 4 times time t.display (whole sound). spectrogram drawn twice resolution zooming stays sharp, makes web pages larger: download button saves sound embedded web page (named sound file ‘Wave’ object), full screen button enlarges player size screen (e.g. presentations; web browsers may allow full screen embedded frames).
code: ds_scythebill + ds_player(speeds = 1, buttons = character()) ds_antshrike +   ds_player(     speeds = c(0.5, 1, 0.25),     buttons = c("time", "loop", "volume", "download", "fullscreen")   ) +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 2, loop = 2) ds_antshrike +   ds_overview() +   ds_theme_macaulay() +   ds_player(buttons = c("zoom", "volume", "time")) +   ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE)

title: package overview
text: Dynamic spectrograms built layers, ‘ggplot2’ graphs: dynaspec() takes sound, layers added +: Printing dynaspec object shows interactive web page: press play watch spectrogram along sound, click play point, use speed slider slow sound . R console web pages shown RStudio viewer (web browser), R Markdown Quarto documents (like vignette) embedded document. save_dynaspec() saves web pages, videos images (see Saving). examples use songs brown-billed scythebill great antshrike (scrolling spectrograms) included package. Sounds can ‘Wave’ objects ‘.wav’ ‘.mp3’ files.
code: dynaspec(wave, flim = c(1, 10)) + # the sound (and frequency and time ranges)   ds_spectrogram(wl = 300) + # panels: spectrogram, oscillogram, envelope, spectrum   ds_oscillogram() +   ds_annotations(st) + # highlight parts of the sound   ds_captions("song", start = 0, end = 2) + # text shown during a time range   ds_theme(xlab = "Time (s)") + # customize axis titles, text and colors   ds_player(speeds = c(1, 0.5)) + # customize playback buttons of web pages   ds_scrolling(t.display = 1.7) # spectro style: ds_static() (default), ds_scrolling() or ds_paged() library(dynaSpec) library(seewave)

title: package overview
text: panels added layers shown. spectrogram: spectrogram background color lowest amplitude palette (white default gray palette), quiet parts sound background look . title: package overview
text: speed slider slows sound .
